projects.title: auto fire extinguisher
projects.description: An automatic vehicle fire extinguisher is a self-activating safety device installed in high-risk areas like engine bays or battery compartments. It detects flames or extreme heat (around 120°C) and releases suppressing powder or gas within 3 to 5 seconds without manual operation or vehicle wiring. Prices range from ₹350 to ₹1,500 ($5–$20 USD) for compact units.
